source_analysis_scope: Nine representative midpoint descriptions reused from the same immutable source excerpt; fresh Gemma4 writing and original Warguy synthesis/render executed in this run.
script: An exhausted John Wick receives a brand-new bulletproof suit to survive his next move.
The apex predator became a target after breaking the Continental's sacred rules.
